name: VR Bangers
summary: Premium VR studio: high-production VR scenes and spin-off brands (VRB Trans, VRB Gay, VRConk, etc.) with its own join/billing and an affiliate portal.
ranking_rationale: Second VR entry on our own editorial call: a premium VR studio brand complementing the SLR aggregator pick. Own join-now page and studio product verified live; pricing is not published on the marketing pages at check time.

pricing.notes: No first-party price published on fetched pages; tracker figures not copied.

pros: Multiple branded spin-offs under one brand family
cons: Smaller library than aggregator sites by design

facts.value: Premium VR scenes, multiple branded spin-offs, own join-now page with age-gated checkout
Discounts and bundle offers shown on the studio homepage at check
facts.notes: Percentages are sliding promos, not list prices.

affiliate.commission: Unverified — JS-only portal; sign-up to see current rates
affiliate.notes: VR Bangers’ "Affiliates" menu points to UnzipVR’s affiliate portal. Commission not published pre-signup.
